panickssery2024.authors: Arjun Panickssery, Samuel R. Bowman, Shi Feng

goel2025.title: Great Models Think Alike and this Undermines AI Oversight
goel2025.where: Section 3.2: 'a significant (p < 0.01) positive correlation (average Pearson r=0.84) between LLM-as-a-judge scores and model similarity'. Figure 6 caption: 'LM mistakes are getting more correlated with increasing capabilities'.
goel2025.conditions: Similarity measured by CAPA (overlap in mistakes). The capability trend has no single published coefficient.

metr2026.title: Many SWE-bench-Passing PRs Would Not Be Merged into Main
metr2026.authors: Parker Whitfill, Cheryl Wu, Joel Becker, Nate Rush (METR)
metr2026.where: Summary: 4 active maintainers from 3 SWE-bench Verified repositories reviewed 296 AI-generated PRs; 'roughly half of test-passing SWE-bench Verified PRs' would not be merged, 'even after adjusting for noise in maintainer merge decisions'. Main results: grader averages about 24.2 percentage points (SE 2.7) above the maintainer merge decision.
metr2026.license: (c) 2026 METR, all rights reserved; facts quoted with attribution, nothing reproduced
metr2026.conditions: scikit-learn, Sphinx, pytest; agents from mid-2024 to late 2025, mostly Anthropic models; scores normalized to the golden-patch merge rate (about 68%); maintainers had no CI.
